history.p: Gade started sketching his G minor symphony while he was in Leipzig in January 1853; however, he did not finish it until the spring of 1857, two years after the death of his first wife, Sophie Hartmann. The minor key led to the assumption that the music depicted his sorrow over this loss. Nevertheless Gade himself characterized it as "fresh", whereas the character in reviews was by turns described as "Nordic", "meridional", "gentle" and "cheerful".
